observation.visible_scene: A nighttime outdoor laser show in a narrow plaza or street flanked by illuminated classical buildings on the left and a darker facade with a lit window on the right. A horizontal metal truss spans the middle of the frame, and silhouetted spectators stand clustered at the center near a small tent on the left. Green laser beams project from a low central emission point, fanning upward and outward through visible haze/smoke, with some beams also sweeping horizontally across the scene. The architecture, truss, and crowd positions remain fixed throughout, indicating a static camera.
visible_changes: The fan of green beams continuously reshapes: early frames show a dense, narrow upward spray, which then opens into wider, more spread-out fans and broad horizontal sweeps across the left and right sides.
Around the middle of the segment a wide, bright sheet-like glow forms overhead in the smoke (frames ~7-9), then collapses back into discrete beams.
From roughly frame 13 onward a brighter, yellowish-white diagonal streak appears among the green beams near the center and persists through the later frames, sweeping slightly.
In the final frames the beam fan tilts toward a near-horizontal orientation, projecting a large illuminated curtain across the right side of the plaza.
The crowd silhouettes and the lone figure at the far-right edge remain essentially stationary; no person walks through the beam source.
outside_clip_unknowns: The control method or operator driving the laser pattern changes is not shown.
Whether the segment is part of a larger performance with a defined start or end is unknown; both ends are arbitrary crops.
The cause of the haze/smoke density variations is not visible.
uncertain_details: The yellowish-white streak may be a separate-color laser or an overexposed green beam; its true color cannot be confirmed.
Any camera motion is negligible but not fully ruled out given the dark, low-contrast background.
The exact number and origin points of the lasers behind the truss are obscured by glare and smoke.
